[IDSP.11.4] **Cache callbacks: one setter, two optional
persistence callbacks.**
`ds_engine_cache_callbacks(engine, set_cb, delete_cb,
user)` ([IDSP.7.4]). The engine owns the cache state and
read path ([LSTO.4.7]); the set / delete callbacks are optional
write-through persistence hooks, NULL ⇒ a volatile
in-engine cache.
